question: On new independently encrypted reference images, does sign consistency across fixed proxy inversion step counts predict original target encrypted bits better than magnitude from the50-step proxy inversion?

tasks.prompt: A photograph of a green bicycle leaning against a brick wall.
A photograph of a bowl of strawberries on a kitchen counter.
A photograph of a white sailboat on a lake.
A photograph of a brown leather backpack on a wooden chair.

watermark.material_policy: For each reference, fresh independent message32 bytes,key32 bytes,nonce16 bytes from OS randomness; exact material retained evaluator-private and only SHA256 fingerprints published; no values in command lines or logs
watermark.sampling_scope: Four independently sampled encryption states, not multiple images from a shared state; no population inference

proxy_scores.consistency: min over t in{25,50,100} of s50_i*z_t_i/RMS(z_t); s50=+1 when z50_i>=0 else-1
proxy_scores.normalization: RMS over all coordinates per image and step count; fail on zero/nonfinite RMS
proxy_scores.tie_break: Higher score first, then ascending flattened C-order index

reference_prediction: Q(z50) where Q is the official l=1 CDF quantizer; require equality with sign quantization for every compared saved array or stop interpretation

evaluation.primary: Per-image difference in original-bit error rate at fixed50% coverage: baseline risk minus consistency risk; report all four paired differences and mean
secondary: AUROC for correctness of Q(z50) against original target Q(zT), null when either class absent
Same paired risks versus target reference reinversion Q(z50_target), reported separately
evaluation.labels: Evaluator-only original target initial noise bins; target reinversion bins are a separate label source
evaluation.unit: reference image;16384 coordinates are correlated observations, not16384 independent samples
evaluation.acceptance_claim: No candidate attack, no full-defense evaluation, no automatic promotion of a score to an attack weight

information_boundary.seal: Hash all proxy arrays and both score vectors before evaluator reads them; no evaluator output passed to proxy jobs

device_rule: Fresh idle and UUID checks before each child; bind UUID and use cuda:0
stop_rules: Engineering failure stops group; preserve evidence and do not retry unchanged version
Do not change step counts, scores, coverages or labels after inspecting target results
A disagreement with sign quantizer stops corresponding mathematical interpretation, not silent substitution
required_before_launch: Official GS explicit-state CPU compatibility check using synthetic transient material without publishing secret values
CPU score/tie/AUROC/coverage checks including absent classes
Exclusive writes, seals, private-material exclusion and process-controller checks
Model/upstream/environment pins and full runtime hashes
Current process, storage and cumulative execution inventory checks
